children: Pearson's appointment of Cevian Capital partner Alex Svensson as a nonexecutive director isn't seen as a signal for a potential change in the strategic direction of the education company, Citi analysts write. Svensson says Cevian has "strong conviction in Pearson's leadership, strategy, and value potential." His appointment continues constructive engagement with the company over six years, he adds. Cevian has a 19.4% stake in Pearson, according to LSEG. Citi has a neutral rating on the stock and 13.45-pound target price. Shares are down 0.25% at 11.95 pounds.(ian.walker@wsj.com)
